summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, attached a press release announcing the first patient treated in its ADMIRE study, a clinical trial evaluating its Alpha DaRT therapy for immunocompromised patients with recurrent cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a clinical milestone with no special-situation event (no acquisition, divestiture, board change, or capital markets transaction). The registrant is the issuer. What to watch: clinical trial enrollment and regulatory updates.
